profile.about: 23, Berlin. Master's student in urban planning

messages.text: hi! can you help me organise my week? thesis is eating me alive
Of course. What's the thesis about, and when is it due?
bike-lane networks in german cities, how connected they actually are. due in march. my supervisor is prof weber
Sounds like a solid topic. How far along are you, and what's the next thing Prof. Weber expects from you?
lit review is half done. i need to send him an outline by friday
Then let's protect two long blocks for the lit review before Friday. Do you work or have classes alongside this?
i work saturdays and sundays at a cafe, so weekdays are mine. i live in a student dorm in wedding, its pretty loud tho
Got it, weekdays for the thesis and weekends at the cafe. Would the university library be quieter than the dorm for your two blocks?
yes definitely. tue and thu mornings then
Tuesday and Thursday mornings at the library, outline out by Friday. Want a short checklist for what the outline should contain?

recalls: What is Lena's thesis about and who supervises it?

messages.text: weber liked the outline!! but he says he's going on leave from october, for a few months
Good news about the outline, less great about the leave. Does he know who will take over your thesis in March?
not yet, the department will assign someone. kinda stressed
That's understandable. Could you ask him for written feedback now, so a new supervisor can see where the bike-lane work stands?
good idea. also random, i want to go home to my parents in freiburg for christmas. should i book a flight now?
Booking early usually helps. Which days are you thinking, and are you flying out of Berlin?
23 dec to 2 jan, from BER. my cafe boss needs to approve the time off too
Ask the cafe for the time off first, then book. Want me to draft a short message to your boss?
yes pls, casual tone
Here's a draft: Hi! I'd love to be off from 23 Dec to 2 Jan to visit my parents, I can cover extra shifts in November if that helps. Does that work? Shall I tweak it?
update: i got a new supervisor, dr. brandt. met her today
How did the meeting go? And did she say anything about the bike-lane topic Prof. Weber approved?
she thinks my topic is too broad for 6 months. she wants me to narrow it to cargo-bike delivery routes
That is a much tighter scope. Does cargo-bike delivery feel interesting to you, or more like a compromise?
actually kinda excited, there's real data from last-mile pilots. but i have to redo my research question
Your lit review on bike-lane networks still helps, since routes depend on the network. Want to draft a new research question together?
yes. something like: how do bike-lane gaps affect cargo-bike delivery routes in berlin
Good start. Maybe add a measurable angle, like route length or delivery time. Which of those could you get data for?
route length for sure. ill ask brandt about time data
ok the dorm is driving me insane, neighbours party every night. i'm looking at shared flats
Fair, that's hard with a thesis due. Any area in mind, or a budget?
neukoelln ideally, close to the ubahn. max 500 warm
Neukölln has plenty of WGs in that range. Do you already have viewings lined up?
one on thursday, two flatmates, a guy and a girl. they sound nice
Nice. What would you like to ask them about, rent split, quiet hours, who cleans what?
quiet hours definitely, i need to write at home. and whether they cook together
Both good questions. Want a short list of five to ask on Thursday so you don't forget any?
yes please

recalls: Where does Lena live and where is she moving?

messages.text: I GOT THE FLAT
Congratulations! Is it the Neukölln one with the two flatmates?
yes!! flatmates are jonas and mira. room is 480 warm. i move in on 27 sept
Great price. Have you told the dorm office, and do you have a way to move your things?
dorm notice is done. my friend has a car, so thats sorted
Perfect. Do you need to register your new address at the Bürgeramt, or sort an internet contract?
oh right the anmeldung. i have to book that. internet is already in the flat
Appointments can be scarce, so book it today if you can. Shall I put a reminder for it in your week?
yes, remind me tomorrow morning
moved yesterday!! boxes everywhere but it's so quiet here
Congrats on the move! How are Jonas and Mira, and is your desk set up yet?
they're great, mira made dinner for all of us. desk is not set up lol
Dinner on day one is a good sign. What do you need most to get the desk working, a lamp, a chair?
just a lamp. also, i'm thinking about quitting the cafe. weekends are the only time i get to rest
That makes sense. Would you still need the income, or is there another option?
brandt offered me a research assistant job at the uni, weekday afternoons. pays better
That sounds like a strong option, and relevant to your cargo-bike work. Have you said yes yet?
not yet, ill decide this week

recalls: Where does Lena work and what are her job options?

messages.text: decided! i said yes to the RA job. i start monday
Congratulations! Did you already tell the cafe?
yes, i quit today. my last shift is this sunday
That was a big step. Are the RA hours weekday afternoons, so your mornings stay free for the thesis?
yep, 1 to 5 mon to fri. mornings for the thesis, weekends off finally
That's a good rhythm. Do you want help planning a weekly schedule with thesis mornings and RA afternoons?
yes. and i want one free evening for the flat dinners
Sure. Would Wednesday work as your flat dinner evening, or does another day suit Jonas and Mira better?
wednesday is good, they said so too

recalls: What does Lena eat or avoid eating?

messages.text: ok random: mira is vegetarian and i've been eating her cooking, i think i'm going vegetarian too
That's a big change. Is it a trial, or are you pretty set on it?
pretty set. no meat from now on, fish too. cheese and eggs are fine
Okay, vegetarian with dairy and eggs. Want a few easy weeknight recipes for between thesis and RA hours?
yes!! quick ones. i used to live on chicken and rice lol
Try chickpea curry with rice, or a lentil bolognese. Both take about 25 minutes and keep well. Which sounds better?
lentil bolognese. i'll make it wednesday for the flat dinner
Nice plan. Do Jonas or Mira have any dietary needs I should keep in mind for the shopping list?
so about christmas, i've been reading about flying and i feel bad about it. i think im taking the train to freiburg instead
That's a nice option. You'd planned 23 Dec to 2 Jan, right? Are you thinking of a direct train from Berlin?
yes same dates. it's about 8 hours with one change i think. I can work on my thesis on the train
Eight hours is a perfect stretch for reading data. Did you book the flight already, or can you skip that?
no flight booked luckily. i need to book the train and a seat reservation
Tickets for the 23rd tend to sell out, so booking soon is wise. Want me to remind you to do it this week?
yes, thursday evening. and tell my parents, my dad will love it
Reminder set for Thursday evening. Will your parents pick you up at the station in Freiburg?

portrait: Lena Fischer is a 23-year-old urban planning master's student in Berlin, writing a thesis on cargo-bike delivery routes under Dr. Brandt, due in March. She lives in a shared flat in Neukölln with Jonas and Mira, works as a university research assistant on weekday afternoons, and is vegetarian. She plans to take the train to her parents in Freiburg for Christmas.
